domains.description: One or more domain pack names. Each is merged into the apd-domain skill. The first is the declared-order primary for deterministic output ordering.

subject.description: Human-readable name of the system under review, shown as the report title/subject. When omitted, the report build derives a name from cbm_project (repo name) and falls back to the run id.

repos.description: Optional multi-repo declaration. Each entry names one CBM project the system spans. When present, code-recon attributes per-repo evidence and may request a cross-repo-intelligence pass. cbm_project (singular) remains valid for single-repo runs; prefer subject: for the report title in multi-repo mode.

cbm_project.description: CBM project name for this repo (must match the operator's indexed project).

role.description: Optional role of this repo in the system. The primary repo seeds report titling and crown-jewel proximity.

repo_path.description: Optional path-traversal-guarded relative location of this repo's source under inputs/, for cross-referencing.

projections.description: ADR-0022 derived compliance projections to emit: the synthesizer projects the run's NIST 800-53r5 coverage into these auditor frameworks via a published crosswalk. Opt-in (not a specialist-emission taxonomy); a derived coverage view, never an audit attestation.

threat_model.description: Path (relative to the run directory) to a supplied threat model. When set, apd-threat-model-recon activates.

methodology_hint.description: Optional hint to the recon parser when the methodology can't be auto-detected from the file shape.

crown_jewels.description: Optional run-level override of the domain pack's crown_jewels[].pattern values. Specialists and the attack-path analyzer treat these as the run's protected targets. Empty list disables attack-path analysis for the run even if the domain declares defaults.

attacker_positions.description: Optional run-level override of the domain pack's attacker_positions[].position values. Used by the attack-path analyzer as enumeration starting points.

attack_path_analysis.description: Tuning knobs for the attack-path analyzer. All fields optional; absent fields fall back to defaults (max_hop=8, max_paths_per_pair=50, bottleneck_threshold=5).

max_hop.description: Maximum hop depth for path enumeration. Bounded at 12 to keep enumeration tractable on partial graphs.

max_paths_per_pair.description: Maximum paths emitted per (attacker_position, crown_jewel) pair. Bounded at 200; paths are sorted by descending severity_sum then ascending hop_count before truncation.

bottleneck_threshold.description: Minimum number of enumerated paths an edge must appear on to be tagged as a bottleneck edge for the D3FEND overlay.

infrastructure.description: Declarative infrastructure-as-code intake. mode discriminates the introspection depth; absent is treated as disabled. Only static is implemented today; the live mode and its sub-block are reserved for a future release.

mode.description: disabled (no infra parsing) | static (parse declared IaC globs) | live (privileged read-only cluster introspection — reserved for a future release, not yet implemented). Absent is treated as disabled.

static.description: IaC parsing globs, each relative to the run's inputs/ directory. Path-traversal-guarded: no leading '/' and no '..' segment.
